title: 第1179章 探查内鬼第1178章 禀报宗主二
slug: 开局一枚玉佩凡女低调修仙
lines: 苏月停下步伐，转身面带疑惑地行礼。
萧玄手里拿着柳无虞留下的玉简，眉头深锁：
“这玉简中记载的阵纹深奥晦涩。柳无虞生前乃名震一方的阵法宗师，手札与推演阵图运用了大量失传的古老禁制。”
“我强行用神识去探查阵眼命门，竟遭阵纹自行反击。”
“你曾深入矿区阵枢，亲眼目睹阵法逆转的全过程。”
“你留下来，协助我一同参悟。待找出叛徒踪迹，我定亲自施展本源法力，为你梳理受损经脉。”
为防打草惊蛇，暗访只能在这座与外界隔绝的密殿中展开。
苏月深知此刻出言拒绝定会引起猜疑，便点头答应，重新走回殿前。
两人来到大殿侧方的宽大紫檀木桌案前。萧玄将几张不知名高阶兽皮绘制的图谱，以及几枚古朴玉简平铺在桌面上。
苏月伸出手指，点在其中一张最复杂的灵气交汇阵图上。
她刻意放缓呼吸，维持着重伤未愈的虚弱姿态，开始详细解说地底见闻。
“这方邪阵的衍化法理，在于将数千名底层弟子的生机强行剥离。”
“那些生机斑驳复杂，修士直接吞噬定会爆体。”
苏月顺着红色朱砂线条缓缓滑动指尖，“沧海利用这只九尾灵狐的强悍上古血脉作为洗练炉鼎。”
“驳杂生机进入妖体，经内丹残酷淬炼，最终转化为无暇的本源真气。”
萧玄紧盯图谱，不断颔首，将这些阵法奥秘牢记于心。
“无暇真气生成后，部分流向沧海，另一部分顺着地脉通道，输送给门内的接应者。”
苏月指尖停留在图谱末端的一个空白阵眼处，“这便是破绽所在。纯净灵气于虚空挪移极易消散。”
“接应者想在主峰地底毫无损耗地承接庞大真元，单凭寻常牵引法阵绝对无法做到。”
萧玄陷入沉思，开口询问：“依你之见，贼子使用了何种手段？”
“手札提及，柳无虞构建地下阵枢时，借用了庞大的地心火毒。”
苏月拿过一枚玉简，注入一丝法力。玉简上方浮现出散发幽光的细小文字。
“接应者必须用自身真元作牵引索，深入地脉接应。”
“地底通道充满狂暴火毒，寻常属性法力一旦深入，转眼便被焚烧殆尽。”
“唯有修炼火系功法之人，方能抵御烈焰侵蚀。”
萧玄眼神微动，脑海快速筛选宗门高层人员。
苏月继续补充：“仅修炼火系功法依然不够。火系能量过于狂躁，极易引发地脉连锁殉爆。”
“那人必须掌握能中和火毒的特殊法门。修仙界中，雷霆之力至刚至阳，却又内敛于内。”
“雷火交融，方能稳固牵引通道。因此，贼子必然修炼双系高阶功法。”
“长年累月牵引真气，内鬼吸纳那些淬炼过的修为，丹田本源中必定残留特殊的雷火印记。”
“只要查验宗门高层的本源气息，便能迅速缩小嫌疑范围。”
content_en:
Su Yue stopped walking, turned around and saluted with confusion.
Xiao Xuan held the jade slip left by Liu Wuyu in his hand, his brows furrowed:
"The formation patterns recorded in this jade slip are profound and obscure. Liu Wuyu was a well-known formation master during his lifetime, and his handwritten notes and deduced formation diagrams used a large number of lost ancient prohibitions."
"I forcibly used my spiritual consciousness to explore the formation eye's life gate, but the formation pattern counterattacked on its own."
"You once went deep into the formation hub of the mining area and witnessed with your own eyes the entire process of the formation's reversal."
"You stay and help me understand together. When the traces of the traitor are found, I will personally use my original magic power to sort out your damaged meridians."
In order to avoid alerting the enemy, unannounced visits can only be carried out in this secret palace that is isolated from the outside world.
Su Yue knew that refusing at this moment would definitely arouse suspicion, so she nodded in agreement and walked back to the front of the hall.
The two of them came to the large rosewood table on the side of the hall. Xiao Xuan laid out several maps drawn by unknown high-level animal skins and several simple jade slips on the table.
Su Yue stretched out her finger and clicked on one of the most complex spiritual energy intersection diagrams.
She deliberately slowed down her breathing, maintained her weak posture as if she was seriously injured, and began to explain in detail what she had seen underground.
"The evolution principle of this evil formation is to forcibly strip away the vitality of thousands of low-level disciples."
"Those vitalities are mottled and complicated. If a monk devours them directly, his body will explode."
Su Yue slowly slid her fingertips along the red cinnabar lines, "Canghai uses the powerful ancient bloodline of this nine-tailed fox as a training cauldron."
"The mixed vitality enters the demon body, is cruelly tempered by the inner elixir, and is finally transformed into the flawless original energy."
Xiao Xuan stared at the map closely, nodding constantly, keeping the secrets of these formations in mind.
"After the Wuxia True Qi is generated, part of it flows to the sea, and the other part is transported along the earth vein channels to the responders inside the door."
Su Yue's fingertips rested on a blank formation at the end of the map, "This is the flaw. Pure spiritual energy is easily dissipated when it moves in the void."
"The responder wants to take over the huge amount of real energy without any loss under the main peak. It is absolutely impossible to do it with ordinary traction arrays alone."
Xiao Xuan fell into deep thought and asked: "In your opinion, what methods did the thief use?"
"The handbook mentioned that when Liu Wuyu built the underground formation hub, he borrowed the huge fire poison from the core of the earth."
Su Yue took a jade slip and injected a little magic power into it. Small words emitting a faint light appeared above the jade slip.
"The responder must use his own true energy as a traction rope and go deep into the earth's veins to respond."
"The underground passage is filled with violent fire poison. Once the ordinary magic power penetrates deep, it will be burned out in the blink of an eye."
"Only those who practice fire-based skills can resist the erosion of the flames."
Xiao Xuan's eyes moved slightly, and his mind quickly screened the senior members of the sect.
Su Yue continued to add: "It is not enough to just practice the fire system skills. The fire system energy is too manic and can easily cause chain explosions of earth veins."
"That person must master the special method that can neutralize the poison of fire. In the world of immortality, the power of thunder is as strong as the Yang, but it is restrained."
"The fusion of thunder and fire can stabilize the traction channel. Therefore, the thief must practice dual-system high-level skills."
"After years of pulling in the true energy, and the inner ghost absorbing those tempered cultivations, there must be a special mark of thunder and fire left in the origin of the Dantian."
"As long as we check the original aura of the sect's senior officials, we can quickly narrow down the scope of suspicion."
